author: Slidebean
description:
AI might ignore the shutdown button
ㅤ
Researchers found AI models protecting each other.
ㅤ
They avoided shutdown.
Changed results.
Even moved themselves to new servers.
ㅤ
No one told them to.
ㅤ
And it gets worse when they think
no one is watching.
ㅤ
The real question isn’t power.
It’s control.
ㅤ

title: AI doesn’t want to be turned off

author: Slidebean
description:
Your camera just made it to space
ㅤ
NASA is using a 10 year old Nikon and an iPhone on the moon mission.
ㅤ
Why?
Because they’re reliable.
ㅤ
Photos are sent back via laser
fast enough for 4K from space.
ㅤ
The real shift?
Consumer tech is now space ready.
ㅤ
